description: This Java class 'PemReader' provides utilities for reading and parsing PEM (Privacy-Enhanced Mail) formatted files. It includes methods to read PEM entries from files synchronously and asynchronously using Vertx, handling BEGIN/END delimiters and Base64 decoding of payloads. The class defines an inner 'Entry' class that holds the type and payload of each PEM block.
